subject: E-Commerce
title: Invisible Checkout
description: A quick, practical guide to Invisible Checkout.

hook.text: Amazon Go stores have no checkout. You grab items, walk out, and your account is charged automatically.

buildup.text: Every step in checkout causes friction. Drop-off rates at each step: address entry 10%, payment 15%, confirmation 8%.

discovery.text: One-click buying reduced checkout to zero friction. Apple Pay and Google Pay shrink the process to a biometric scan.

twist.text: Invisible checkout removes the 'pain of paying.' When you don't feel the transaction, you spend 20-30% more.

climax.text: Frictionless checkout benefits convenience but removes the psychological guardrail that prevents overspending.

punchline.text: Walk out, account charged. Invisible payments boost spending 20-30%.

quiz.question: What psychological effect does invisible checkout have on spending?
options: Removing the 'pain of paying' causes people to spend 20-30% more
